subject: dsa
title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
summary: Encode the tree with a preorder walk, writing # for each null child. Decoding reads that string left to right and rebuilds the identical tree.
problem: Encode a binary tree to a string and decode it back. Use preorder, writing # for a null child.

example.output: serialized "1,2,#,#,3,4,#,#,5,#,#", then decoded back to the same tree

steps.caption: Encode the tree to a string and decode it back. Use preorder and write # for nulls.
Serialize in preorder, visiting root then left then right. The string starts "1,2,...".
Finish the preorder walk. The full string is "1,2,#,#,3,4,#,#,5,#,#".
Deserialize: read the string left to right and rebuild 1, then 2, then 3 with children 4 and 5.
Done. The decoded tree matches the original exactly.
